verdict.rationale: Quo documents message history that can be filtered by contact, call history with transcripts, and AI summaries attached to call records. It also documents shared numbers so the team stays aligned, which together approximate a contact-centric shared history. It does not explicitly document calls and texts threaded in a single per-contact timeline, team-visible contact notes, or shared-inbox visibility of that history. Missing for 10: explicit unified per-contact call+text thread, contact notes feature, documented team-wide visibility of contact history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees

citations.quote: Pull message history from any Quo inbox, filter by contact, date, or topic
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
Share one number and stay aligned with your team
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones
